newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo Elec sets '97 export at $3.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Elec sets '97 export at $3.8 bln.

text.p: Daewoo Electronics Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Monday it set its 1997 export target at $3.8 billion, up from an estimated $2.8 billion this year.
A Daewoo spokesman said its sales for this year were estimated at 3.8 trillion won, compared with 3.13 trillion in 1995.
Daewoo spokesman Chung Jae-hyun said the company's output would total $5.5 billion in 1997, about 40 percent of which would be produced in overseas countries.
He said Daewoo would strengthen overseas sales of its own brand products, while reducing the proportion of orginal equipment manufacturing (OEM) exports.
Daewoo also plans to invest about $1 billion in the next five years to reinforce its research and development efforts.
